name: Arisawa Fumika
source:
Disciplinary Committee Chair. G Her grades and appearance are on par with Asahi, and she has a polite demeanour and a gentle personality. She hates wrong and crooked things and corrects any irregularities in the school, but she fundamentally believes that people should act at their own risk. She has a close relationship with Asahi and a few trusted friends rather than a large number of friends.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200221221523/http://crossover-game.jp/include/saiminiincho/character.html?20160527]official website[/url]]
